courses.title: DISCERNING INDIA: LIVING CULTURES OF TULUNADU
notes: Listed in the VI semester allocation dataset for AY 2025–26 and independently in a student-posted elective list. Current availability and the MIT elective syllabus have not been verified.

MAHE describes a similarly named online course introducing the cultural heritage of Tulunadu through lectures, video documentaries, and reading materials. Its published units are Yakshagana, Kambala, Naga Worship, Bhuta Worship, Siri Worship, and Pilivesha. Equivalence to the MIT elective has not been verified.

The related certificate is offered by the Centre for Intercultural Studies and Dialogue (CISD), housed in Manipal Centre for European Studies. CISD documents an original two-credit/four-unit version and a three-credit/six-unit version from February 2025. Neither establishes the credit structure of IIE 4334.
Related reading: Living Cultures of Tulunadu, Praveen Shetty and Nithesh Anchan, Manipal Universal Press. The book has not been verified as prescribed reading for the MIT elective.
